status: Architecture and acceptance contract; native applications and services are not implemented
permanent_requirements: Phone, tablet and widescreen support is a release requirement, not a later adaptation.
The learner app must continuously build for iOS/iPadOS, Android and web from M1.
No required course objective may silently degrade on another supported platform.
Core has no course-specific branches or imports; domain behavior comes through SDK contracts.
Authorized debug GUI explains agent dispatch, evaluation and committed learning decisions.
Placement is enabled by an administrator and optional for the learner.

recommended_stack.learner: Expo + React Native + React Native Web; MIT
recommended_stack.admin: Responsive React web application; shared headless contracts
recommended_stack.model_tool_gateway: AI SDK; Apache-2.0; direct provider adapters allowed
recommended_stack.policy: Versioned deterministic typed functions; optional OPA adapter
recommended_stack.graph_alternative: LangGraph MIT; not a second default durable authority
recommended_stack.observability: OpenTelemetry Apache-2.0 + core domain inspector; optional Langfuse MIT-core adapter
recommended_stack.eval_regression: Promptfoo MIT + deterministic/property tests + independent rubric fixtures
recommended_stack.license_rule: Pin release versions and inspect transitive/bundled licenses. No mandatory paid enterprise modules. API/hosting/store costs are separate.

not_build_evidence: a claim that native packaging can be added later

invariants: No global score skips an untested critical prerequisite
Assisted or incomplete evidence does not become independent mastery
Exemptions do not fabricate lesson completion or retention
Learner can revisit or start earlier
Provider failure is not a wrong answer

sdk_extension_levels.purpose: portable content, policies and shipped activity types
custom activities/tools with isolated execution and validated events
administrator-installed evaluators, integrations and agent strategies
compile-time app extensions; requires rebuild/review, no dynamic privilege escalation

debug_record.privacy: Scoped server authorization; redacted by default; explicit payload access and audit; no credential logging or invented hidden model reasoning
debug_record.replay: Frozen inputs, isolated side effects, new trace ID, no real progress writes

acceptance_cases.case: Native-target build breaks while web passes
acceptance_cases.expected: Release blocked; native readiness is mandatory.

acceptance_cases.case: Tablet enters split view during an answer
acceptance_cases.expected: Layout adapts without losing draft, focus, objective or companion context.

acceptance_cases.case: Software keyboard or large text obscures primary action
acceptance_cases.expected: Layout/scroll/focus corrected; no inaccessible required step.

acceptance_cases.case: App killed after submission before acknowledgement
acceptance_cases.expected: Resume/reconcile once; no duplicate assessment or false completion.
Result visibly pending authoritative evaluation; no unsupported skips.

acceptance_cases.case: Required custom activity lacks native support
acceptance_cases.expected: Fail declared-target validation unless an objective-equivalent fallback is supplied.

acceptance_cases.case: Course attempts to load new native capabilities dynamically
acceptance_cases.expected: Denied; requires declared compiled module/release process.
Normal starting path remains available without penalty.

acceptance_cases.case: High placement average but missing prerequisite evidence
acceptance_cases.expected: Dependent units remain required or get a diagnostic; no blanket skip.
Earlier start available; original evidence retained accurately.

acceptance_cases.case: Public demo requires private-course code in core

acceptance_cases.expected: Documented SDK extension works without core edits.
Server redacts/denies despite direct API request or UI flag.
Critical domain receipts remain durable; missing traces are explicit and buffers bounded.

acceptance_cases.case: Debug replay attempts real learner mutation or external tool effect
acceptance_cases.expected: Sandbox denies; production change requires separate authorized command.

acceptance_cases.case: Placement or gate decision cannot be linked to evidence/version
